Guardian Citadel.description: The ancient seat of the Guardians, humming with green light.

Corps Armory.description: Racks of dormant lantern batteries line the walls.

Hall of Lanterns.description: A vast hall lined with the glowing emblems of fallen and living Lanterns. Four passages branch away from a central dais.

Will Forge.description: Molten green energy pours through channels in the floor. The air presses against your ring, daring you to falter.

Garden of Mogo.description: A living garden on the sentient planet Mogo. Half the plants are wilting, and a faint blue glow pulses at the centre.

Void of Fear.description: Darkness swallows the walls. Your ring flickers, and something unseen whispers just behind you.

Central Power Battery Chamber.description: The Central Power Battery towers above you, a colossal lantern blazing with the light of a billion wills.
